versions.changelog:
opc-project-screener v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for systematic, multi-stage evaluation of early-stage OPC (one-person company) projects.
- Supports five-round discussion: direction, team & market, technology & business model, finance & risk, and final synthesis.
- Uses conversational, consultant-style guidance focused on user participation and consensus, not one-off scoring.
- Provides a structured yet flexible workflow for assessing real demand, OPC fit, technical feasibility, market validation, and financial health.
- Outputs records in a user-friendly summary format, including action items and consensus-based recommendations.
